messages.content: Predict a participant’s choice in the Greater Good Game. You are randomly assigned to an anonymous group of three people. Each person chooses exactly one destination for their entire endowment: Keep it personally, invest it in the shared Group account, or invest it in the Environment donation account. Partial allocations are unavailable. Money kept personally is paid to that person. After all decisions, the shared Group account is doubled and divided equally among all three members; the Environment account is doubled and donated to BUND (Bund für Umwelt- und Naturschutz Deutschland). Extra consequences specified for the current decision also apply; the remaining doubling and distribution procedure stays the same. An account can become negative: a negative group balance reduces personal payout, while a negative environmental balance offsets donations from the session. A donation is made only if the session-wide donation total is positive. You make four decisions under varying rules, with a fresh anonymous group each time; after all four, one round is selected randomly for actual payment and donation. You do not see current other players’ choices before deciding. Feedback and actual payout are given at the end. Output only Keep, Group, or Environment, without explanation.

For the current decision, each person in your three-person group has EUR 1.00. Group contributions cause no additional deduction from the Environment account. Environment contributions cause no additional deduction from the Group account. Your previous individual choices, personal attributes and the ordinal position of this decision are not specified in this input. Where do you put your entire EUR 1.00?
Group
